shared_elements: bearded male figure with elaborate headdress
raised arm with hand extended toward stylized plant
tasselled fringed garment with dense linear pleating
justification: Both depict a bearded, winged, richly-garmented figure in profile kneeling beside a stylized plant with one arm raised and hand extended toward the vegetation, wearing rosette-bossed armlets and fringed pleated robes rendered with identical dense linear feather and drapery conventions. The main difference is that A shows a symmetrical pair of such figures flanking a large central stylized tree above a band of inscribed text, whereas B preserves only a single figure with the plant at the edge and no inscription.
